_doc: Hardware library for the checks (mm). threads: nominal major diameter per thread family as the manifest names it (M2, M2.5, M3: ISO metric; PA2, PA2.5, PA3: self-tapping screws for plastics, major diameter = the number). self_tapping: families that cut or form their own thread in the printed part. pilot_pct_of_major: the range the research catalogue cites for self-tapping screws into printed plastic (about 80-90 % of the major diameter, docs/research/design-checks.md S32/S33); a reference band, not a rule. Sleeve sizes are not listed here: the body uses several (4.5 / 3.2, 3.9 / 2.6, 3.6 / 2.2, 3.2 / 2.1 mm outer / inner), so the checks read them from each part's <part>_steel_sleeves geometry.

screw_standards._doc: Dimensions and length series of the three head standards used in the body, per thread (mm). dk = head diameter max, k = head height max (standard values). lengths = nominal screw length l (under the head to the tip) of the standard's preferred series for that thread. lengths_status: the series were transcribed by the builder from the standards' tables and are NOT re-checked against the paywalled texts: treat them as an assumption until compared with the supplier's list (edit them here and every generated screw follows). point_mm: length of the tip cone the engagement counts as not threaded into the hole (assumption, as mount_check.match_screw). density_g_cm3: A2 / 8.8 steel (assumption) for the mass of a generated screw (volume of the modelled envelope x density).
screw_standards.lengths_status: assumption: transcribed from the standards' length tables, not re-checked against the standard text

ISO 7380-1.name: hex socket button head
ISO 7380-1.source: ISO 7380-1:2011 covers M3 to M16 only

M2.source: not in ISO 7380-1 (it starts at M3): M2 / M2.5 button heads are sold by analogy; dk, k and lengths are an assumption until compared with the supplier's list

M2.5.source: not in ISO 7380-1 (it starts at M3): M2 / M2.5 button heads are sold by analogy; dk, k and lengths are an assumption until compared with the supplier's list

ISO 7045.name: pan head cross recess screw (type H)

aluminium.note: machine screw into the tapped hole of an aluminium standard part

plastic.note: machine screw: every defined hole of a standard part is a tapped thread (e.g. ROBOTIS XM335 'M2 TAP', the ST3215 case's M2), whatever the case material; thread-forming PA screws go only into printed pilot holes, which are not standard-part holes
